failureGroups.symptom: Browser startup test could not find the START AUDIO control.
AudioContext recovery error was not shown in the expected alert.
Repeated Browser recovery observed output gain 0 instead of the expected 37.
Browser stereo recording rejected a stale input capture frame.
Classic LCD Memory display differed from the older expected labels.
Classic LCD editor focus differed from the expected encoder focus.
Classic FX editor now shows page 2/4; the test expected 2/3.

checks: Seven Classic Play screens cycle and return.
Two-channel distinct virtual input records, plays, overdubs and stops through panel controls.
Mark SET and CLEAR complete through the Classic secondary control layer.
Track FX gate returns to confirmed bypass with matching input and playback revisions.

additionalAttempt.context: A second expanded smoke ran while the complete Playwright suite was loading/testing in parallel; the shared capture correctly rejected the requested start frame outside retained pre-roll. No timeout was increased and no retry was used to turn this into PASS.

limitations: No physical loopback, audibility or latency claim.
Memory and FX Bank have separate browser regression coverage.

performance.note: Historical software ABBA recorded 43 deadline exceedances; no final-source performance PASS is claimed.

visual.note: Independent final screenshot review found no new high-impact issue; physical geometry remains approximate and LED photometry unmeasured.
